a: 24 months, possibly extendable; €28,761.73 gross per year, plus a first-year mobility incentive of €4,242.05 for eligible candidates
e: Postdoc at INFN Torino developing, building and testing a demonstrator 4D tracker based on resistive LGAD silicon sensors and their readout electronics, including lab tests, test beams and performance analysis. Open to Italian and foreign citizens with a PhD in physics or an equivalent foreign degree; apply through the INFN recruitment portal.
n: INFN: Postdoc on a 4D tracking system with resistive silicon detectors (RSD) and readout electronics
